== routes/create-pets.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Route
metadata:
  name: create-pets
spec:
  match:
    path:
      exact: /v1/pets
    methods:
      - POST
  upstreams:
    - name: petstore-example
== routes/delete-pets-pet-id.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Route
metadata:
  name: delete-pets-pet-id
spec:
  match:
    path:
      template: "/pets/{pet_id}"
    methods:
      - DELETE
  upstreams:
    - name: admin-petstore-example-8080
== routes/get-photo.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Route
metadata:
  name: get-photo
spec:
  match:
    path:
      regex: "/v1/pets/[^/]+/photo\\.[^/]+"
    methods:
      - GET
  upstreams:
    - name: petstore-example
== routes/list-pets.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Route
metadata:
  name: list-pets
spec:
  match:
    path:
      exact: /v1/pets
    methods:
      - GET
  upstreams:
    - name: petstore-example
== routes/show-pet-by-id.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Route
metadata:
  name: show-pet-by-id
spec:
  match:
    path:
      template: "/v1/pets/{pet_id}"
    methods:
      - GET
  upstreams:
    - name: petstore-example
== ruralz.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: edge
spec:
  listeners:
    - name: http
      protocol: http
      port: 8080
== upstreams/admin-petstore-example-8080.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Upstream
metadata:
  name: admin-petstore-example-8080
spec:
  protocol: http
  endpoints:
    - address: "admin.petstore.example:8080"
== upstreams/petstore-example.yaml
apiVersion: ruralz/v1alpha1
kind: Upstream
metadata:
  name: petstore-example
spec:
  protocol: http
  endpoints:
    - address: "petstore.example:443"
  tls: {}
